inputs.text: Wake up, people, it is so obvious if you just look past the official script. The so-called West Asia conflict is nothing more than a completely staged distraction engineered by the hidden puppet masters pulling the strings to keep everyone compliant. They wheel out former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein to spin the narrative, claiming a political resolution is vital for success, but that is just coded language for the next phase of their coordinated manipulation. When he emphasizes Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs, calling it an ongoing operation, he is actually exposing the exact timeline of their hidden agenda. The elites never intend for it to end because they need this perpetual theater to distract us from their true coordination at the top. Do not believe a single word they are feeding you.
